<thought>To obtain the precursors, I apply retrosynthetic template 1914395 to the fluorinated heterocycle “FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1”. The template replaces the C‑F bond with a C‑O bond, yielding the alcohol “OC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1”. The other molecule in the product pair remains unchanged. Hence the only precursor combination is the unchanged first SMILES together with the generated alcohol.</thought>
<final_answer>[["COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1", "OC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1"]]</final_answer>
